sentences.en: I didn't want to spend any more time swimming laps.
sentences.zh: 我不愿意再花时间在游泳池里游圈了。

sentences.en: No matter how much you lap coal, it stays black.
sentences.zh: 无论你怎样摩擦煤块，它仍然是黑色的。

sentences.en: The impudent child extended her legs across my lap.
sentences.zh: 那个没礼貌的孩子把腿伸到了我的膝盖上。

senses.zh: 使重叠；拍打；包围；缠绕；舔舐；领先一圈
